correctness.rationale: Decomposing the weighted Laplacian into A-zero-sum, B-zero-sum, and between-part contrast eigenspaces gives exact pseudoinverse potentials for either edge-source orbit. Sign-controlled normalized currents yield C_A,C_B and Z_A,Z_B, with complement identity 1+C−2Q_ee. Their differences after positive factor m(mx²+n) reduce to F_C and F_Z. Coefficient signs prove single positive cut/cycle root for m≥4; evaluating F_C−F_Z=2m(x²−(m+n−1)/m) at ξ=sqrt((m+n−1)/m) gives order reversal and unique common root m=2n+1. Concave low-m quadratics establish B–A–B cycle reentrance or the exceptional (2,2) switch. Independent symbolic identities succeeded for all 49 pairs (2≤m,n≤8), and direct grounded-Laplacian inversion reconstructed every edge column on four sample weighted graphs including the tie/boundary cases.
residual_risks: Finite rational reconstructions are not an all-positive-real proof; the spectral and quadratic arguments are.
